description: This JavaScript source file defines API client functions for interacting with backend endpoints, including functions to get health status, analytics, alerts, and to mark alerts as read. It uses fetch for HTTP requests and handles configuration of API base URL and request timeouts.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Resolves the backend base URL from environment variables, with fallback to localhost in development.

methods.name: fetchJson(path, options = {})
methods.description: Performs a fetch request to the given path, handling JSON responses, errors, and request timeouts.

methods.name: getHealth()
methods.description: Fetches the health status of the backend server.

methods.name: getAnalytics({ customerId = "demo_customer", siteId = "demo_site" } = {})
methods.description: Fetches analytics data for a specified customer and site, with default demo values.

methods.name: getAlerts({ customer, site, status } = {})
methods.description: Fetches a list of alerts, with optional filtering parameters for customer, site, and status.

methods.name: markAlertRead(alertId)
methods.description: Marks a specific alert as read, given its alert ID.

ctags.name: getAlerts
ctags.pattern: /^export async function getAlerts({ customer, site, status } = {}) {$/
